change_reason: The first development run exposed insufficient structural semantics, short benchmark samples, incomplete latency observations, thin mutation/sanitizer/recovery records, and no evaluator regression corpus. Thresholds and workload identities remain unchanged.

measurement_policy.order: deterministically counterbalanced within each paired repetition
measurement_policy.outliers: retain every measured sample and every raw batch latency observation
measurement_policy.warmup: three unrecorded executions per workload and implementation
measurement_policy.batching: use the same calibrated iteration count for reference and candidate within each workload
measurement_policy.cpu_affinity: pin the evaluator process to one available CPU when the host permits it and record the result
measurement_policy.uncertainty: deterministic 4000-resample bootstrap confidence interval over paired throughput ratios
measurement_policy.summary: arithmetic mean candidate throughput divided by arithmetic mean reference throughput; paired median and confidence interval are also recorded
measurement_policy.latency: record all aggregate batch latencies and compare the worst per-workload p99 candidate/reference ratio

holdout_policy: No D3 or L5 claim. Repository-visible separated workloads are not represented as blind holdout evidence.
noise_policy: No outlier deletion; paired measurements retained in execution order.
